# Apache Answer authoring and admin reduction

This fixture reduces Apache Answer's question authoring, editor/upload, and
admin question-list shapes at `3b9f1370612e690a0b7f230f05e688930db4c6d3`
(Apache-2.0). Native forms, textarea/file controls, browser-owned draft storage,
and keyed admin mutations replace package form/editor/query runtimes.
